treat_onc_wait.label_en: Oncology treatment queue, in days of referral inflow
treat_onc_wait.definition: Patients waiting for treatment in specialty 65 (oncology) at the reference date, divided by oncology referrals per day in the same period. A queue-pressure index in days; NOT a measured referral-to-treatment or diagnosis-to-treatment time.

treat_onc_over90.label_en: Oncology: share of treatment queue waiting over 90 days
treat_onc_over90.label_fi: Syöpätaudit: yli 90 vrk hoitoa odottaneiden osuus
treat_onc_over90.definition: Of patients waiting for treatment in specialty 65 at the reference date, the share who have waited over 90 days. 90 days is THL's reporting band, not a cancer target time.

treat_surg_over90.label_en: GI surgery + urology: share of treatment queue over 90 days (not cancer-specific)
treat_surg_over90.label_fi: Gastrokirurgia + urologia: yli 90 vrk hoitoa odottaneiden osuus (ei syöpäkohtainen)
treat_surg_over90.definition: Share of the treatment queue over 90 days in specialties 20G and 20U, which operate colorectal, prostate and bladder cancer but mostly treat non-cancer patients. Capacity-pressure context only.

dx_endo_over90.label_en: Endoscopy queue: share waiting over 90 days (not cancer-specific)
dx_endo_over90.label_fi: Tähystysjono: yli 90 vrk odottaneiden osuus (ei syöpäkohtainen)
dx_endo_over90.definition: Of patients waiting for oesophageal, gastric or intestinal endoscopy, the share waiting over 90 days. Endoscopy is the diagnostic step for colorectal and gastric cancer, but the queue includes all indications.

ref_assess_over90.label_en: Waiting for first specialist assessment over 90 days, cancer-diagnosing specialties (not cancer-specific)
ref_assess_over90.label_fi: Hoidon tarpeen arviointia yli 90 vrk odottaneet, syöpiä diagnosoivat erikoisalat (ei syöpäkohtainen)
ref_assess_over90.definition: Of patients waiting for assessment of need for care in pulmonology, gastroenterology, GI surgery, urology and gynaecology, the share waiting over 90 days. All referral reasons.

ref_over21.label_en: Referrals processed later than 21 days, all specialties
ref_over21.label_fi: Yli 21 vrk:ssa käsitellyt lähetteet, kaikki erikoisalat
ref_over21.definition: Share of referrals to specialist care processed in more than 21 days (statutory limit: assessment must begin within 3 weeks of referral). All specialties.

ref_volume_yoy.label_en: Referral volume vs same period a year earlier, all specialties
ref_volume_yoy.definition: Referrals to specialist care in the period divided by the same period one year earlier. Flow signal for the pathway twin and the 2020 positive control.

ctrl_population_yoy.label_en: Negative control: resident population vs a year earlier
ctrl_population_yoy.definition: Resident population reported in the same THL cube, year on year. Should not react to care disruptions.

det_screen_breast.definition: Participants as % of invited, mammography screening. Strategy target: 80% in every county.

det_screen_cervix.definition: Participants as % of invited, cervical screening. Strategy target: 80% in every county.

det_screen_colorectal.definition: Participants as % of invited, colorectal (FIT) screening, programme rolled out from 2022. Strategy target: 80% in every county.
